cells: A content operation changes the body
rows.label: content_revision

data.body:
Failure is explicit

  • 423 means the lease is missing, expired, or held elsewhere.
  • 409 means the expected version or guarded state is stale.
  • 422 means the operation or resulting body violates the contract.
  • 403 means creation, review, or publication policy refused the action.

Publish and release are intentionally separate

A successful publish is committed but not live. One explicit release deploys all accumulated exports, and success requires confirmation that production is serving the target commit.
